purpose: Every literature identifier (PMID, PMCID, Bookshelf NBK) that appears under src/ must be listed here with what it resolved to when it was checked against PubMed. An identifier that is not listed here, and not in LITERATURE_CITATION_DEBT.json, fails the build.
howToAdd: Resolve the identifier against PubMed, copy the authors, title, journal or book, date and DOI exactly as PubMed returns them, and set verifiedOn to the day you looked. Never fill an entry from memory. The online check in CI re-resolves every entry.
gate: scripts/qa/citation-ledger.mjs (offline, in the build) and scripts/qa/citation-ledger-online.mjs (CI, against NCBI E-utilities)
